retained.reason: The checked products consume Horizons VEC_TABLE=1 text as a pinned input. Astroquery 0.4.11 exposes parsed vectors or VEC_TABLE=3 text; changing this route requires migrating the pinned artifact and every receipt together. The complete existing route remains in one implementation.
No candidate package has passed the repository's representative Juno, New Horizons, OSIRIS, DART and IHW products as one complete replacement.

The production TypeScript evaluator is preparation-time infrastructure shared by 22 consumers and is already checked against CSPICE. A partial SpiceyPy path would create two production answers for one operation.
